sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Set up and manage VPC Network Peering
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: gcloud compute networks peerings update accepts --export-custom-routes and --import-custom-routes; '--import-custom-routes tells the network to accept custom routes from the peered network'; for exports 'The peered network must be set to import the routes' and for imports 'The peered network must export the routes first'. The VPC routes page (read 2026-11-18): peering dynamic routes are 'imported with custom route exchange from networks connected using VPC Network Peering'. That on-premises needs the peered range in Cloud Router's custom advertisements for the return path is the author's (the page does not say it; to verify against the Cloud Router advertisement page).
